svg.title: A change adds a record. It does not erase one.
svg.desc: Illustrative records: new message, captured edit and deletion observation. Each event includes the preceding hash; SHA-256 hashes canonical JSON, and Ed25519 signs the raw digest bytes. C denotes canonical encoding. Signatures do not establish Telegram origin or complete capture.

g.aria-label: Each event includes the preceding hash.
Verify with an independently trusted key.
